discrepancies: PRIMARY STATEMENTS: no restatement found - every FY2022 line on the income statement, balance sheet (assets/equity), changes in equity and cash flow is identical between the FY2022 filing and the FY2023 filing's comparatives (the FY2023 filing splits 2022 lease payments into principal 2,819 / interest 295 where the FY2022 filing showed one combined 3,114 line, and starts the cash flow at 'profit before tax' instead of 'net profit' - same figure, 1,000,755).

SEGMENT NOTE (Note 24) FY2022 totals differ by 16,048: original FY2022 filing reports segment total assets 9,638,927 and total liabilities 6,604,185; the FY2023 filing's FY2022 comparatives report 9,654,975 and 6,620,233. The 16,048 difference equals the IPO-cost receivable due from DEWA, excluded from the segment allocation in the original filing but included in the comparative. Statement-of-financial-position totals (9,654,975) are unchanged in both.

NOTE 31 financial-liabilities table: FY2022 filing shows trade and other payables 'excluding deferred revenues and including non-current retention payable' as 1,207,284, but 1,502,766 - 290,225 = 1,212,541; the FY2023 filing's 2022 comparative shows 1,212,541 under the same label. The original figure appears to have excluded the 5,257 non-current retention despite its label.

BRIDGE LOAN AED equivalent for the USD 250,000k Dubai Islamic Bank facility: FY2022 filing states AED 918,125 thousand; FY2023 filing states AED 918,237 thousand (the FY2022 cash flow's 5,418,237 total drawdown is consistent with 918,237 + 4,500,000).
STATUTORY RESERVE transfer rate: FY2022 filing Note 17 says 10% of profit; FY2023 filing Note 17 says 5%. Both note transfers are suspended (reserve at 50% of capital), so no numeric impact.

FY2022 filing internal: Note 19 quotes letters of credit payable to ENBD of AED 4,362,430 while Note 33 quotes total bank guarantees and LCs of AED 4,886,945 (both apparently in AED units, not thousands); the FY2023 filing restates the 2022 comparative as AED 4,887 thousand, consistent with Note 33.

Income-statement geometry note (not a discrepancy between filings): 2021 interest income on the Nakheel financial asset (610) sits in finance income (Note 30), whereas from 2022 the equivalent income (18,545 / 38,711) is a separate face line above cost of sales.

MISSING PAGES: in BOTH filings PDF page 5 (directors' report signature page) and PDF page 13 (report page 11 - the liabilities side of the statement of financial position) are image scans with no extractable text. All liability figures in this file are reconstructed from the notes and verified to the disclosed segment-note total liabilities and to equity + liabilities = total assets for all three years; no number was estimated.
